title: Error responses are plain text, not JSON
evidence: main.go:73,77,82 use http.Error(...) which writes text/plain bodies (e.g. "title and author are required"); only success paths encode JSON
suggestion: Encode error bodies as JSON (e.g. {"error": "..."}) with the Content-Type header for full JSON-response conformance

title: Statement coverage is 59.6% despite all tests passing
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.596, defect_rate=1.0 — build+tests pass but ~40% of statements (mainly main(), initDB error paths, DB-error branches) are unexercised
suggestion: Add tests for 404/400 paths and DB error handling to raise coverage
